reviewDescription: I ordered these based on my usual pant size and they were a mess. The waist ran small while the length width was tight, so I ended up with pants that were tight around my stomach and very tight around legs. There's no consistency to the sizing chart at all — I'd recommend sizing up at least one full size if you order these, and even then I'm not confident it would fix the leg width issue. The bigger problem is the elastic waistband itself. Within about two weeks of regular wear, it had already started to lose its stretch and just sits loose and floppy instead of holding shape. For a "casual elastic waist" pant, that's kind of the whole selling point, so having it fail this early is disappointing. The fabric also feels thinner than I expected from the photos — more like a lightweight lining material than an actual chino weight. It wrinkles if you so much as sit down for twenty minutes, which isn't ideal for something marketed as a golf trouser you'd wear out and about. The tapered cut looked decent in the product photos, but on my body it just looked baggy through the thigh and tight at the ankle in an unflattering way, not a clean taper. The biggest gripe is the back pocket which is not zippered and is really floppy at the opening, so everything falls out when sitting down. I really wanted these to work since the price point seemed reasonable, but between the sizing inconsistency, the elastic failing so quickly, and the flimsy fabric, I ended up returning them. Not a purchase I'd repeat.
